name: Drop Zone Safety-of-Flight Radio Net (UHF/VHF voice)
description: The voice radio channel between the Drop Zone Support Team and the drop aircraft. Deliberately limited-traffic by doctrine, not general coordination chatter: used for safety-of-flight matters (ATC directions, range clearance, unsafe surface conditions, mission changes) and to pass surface wind/limited weather observations. Mandatory for IMC/AWADS (instrument) drops; for standard visual drops, radio contact is used as needed rather than continuously. Represents a class of man-portable UHF/VHF AM radio (e.g. PRC-113-class equipment) generically — no specific real radio's exact frequency or crypto detail is modeled, consistent with the classification boundary (AGENTS.md Section 3).

doctrineSource.note: Army field manual, publicly mirrored on globalsecurity.org. Confirmed via web search on 2026-09-07 that: radio contact with the drop aircraft is limited to safety-of-flight requirements or issues affecting airborne force employment; the DZST passes surface wind/limited weather observations to inbound aircraft when radio contact is made; radio contact is mandatory for IMC/AWADS operations. name: Digital Situational Awareness System (ATAK-class, representative)
description: Represents a modern geospatial/situational-awareness capability in the style of ATAK (Android Team Awareness Kit) — a real, unclassified-discussable, DoD-adopted Android application (originally developed by the Air Force Research Laboratory) used for sharing positions, markers, and zone data via its Cursor on Target (CoT) protocol. Typically bearer-agnostic — cellular, satellite, or tactical mesh radio (e.g. Persistent Systems Wave Relay, Silvus-class MANET radios) rather than consumer Wi-Fi. Included as a plausible modern complement to the doctrinal voice radio net above. IMPORTANT: no source found this session documents ATAK specifically being used for CDS/airdrop drop-zone coordination in official Air Force materiel — this System is representative/illustrative only, not a doctrinally confirmed capability for this mission type.

doctrineSource.publication: Android Team Awareness Kit (ATAK) — general program information
